# datadog_integration_databricks_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog Databricks integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the Databricks integration account. A `bearer_token` method indicates an account still on token authentication, which Databricks accepts only on accounts that already use it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Databricks integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the Databricks integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from Databricks, keyed by dataflow id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `databricks_integration_account_bearer_token_auth` (Attributes) The bearer token authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--databricks_integration_account_bearer_token_auth))
- `databricks_integration_account_o_auth_auth` (Attributes) The Databricks OAuth authentication method and service principal configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--databricks_integration_account_o_auth_auth))
- `databricks_integration_account_private_action_runner_auth` (Attributes) The Private Action Runner authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--databricks_integration_account_private_action_runner_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--databricks_integration_account_bearer_token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.databricks_integration_account_bearer_token_auth`

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `bearer_token`.
- `token_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret token used to authenticate with Databricks. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for token_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.


<a id="nestedatt--authentication--databricks_integration_account_o_auth_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.databricks_integration_account_o_auth_auth`

Required:

- `client_id` (String) Client ID of the Databricks service principal.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret of the Databricks service principal. Generate it under User management > Service principals > Credentials & secrets in Databricks. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state.
- `client_secret_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for client_secret_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `databricks_oauth`. Defaults to `"databricks_oauth"`.
- `azure_tenant_id` (String) Microsoft Entra ID tenant of the service principal, for Azure Databricks workspaces.


<a id="nestedatt--authentication--databricks_integration_account_private_action_runner_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.databricks_integration_account_private_action_runner_auth`

Required:

- `connection_id` (String) Unique identifier of the Private Action Runner connection holding the credentials.
- `user_uuid` (String) Unique identifier of the user the Private Action Runner connection belongs to.

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `private_action_runner`. Defaults to `"private_action_runner"`.
- `secret_path` (String) Path of the credential inside the secret backend configured on the runner.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `workspace_url` (String) URL of the Databricks workspace.

Optional:

- `system_tables_sql_warehouse_id` (String) ID of the SQL warehouse used to query the Databricks system tables.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `databricks_cloud_cost_metrics` (Attributes) Cost data collected from your Databricks system tables. Requires [Cloud Cost Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/) to be set up for your organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_cloud_cost_metrics))
- `databricks_data_observability_jobs_monitoring` (Attributes) Data Jobs Monitoring, which collects performance, reliability, and cost data for your Databricks jobs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_data_observability_jobs_monitoring))
- `databricks_data_observability_quality_monitoring` (Attributes) Data Observability, which collects lineage and data quality information from your Databricks catalogs so you can explore how data flows and detect, resolve, and prevent quality issues. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_data_observability_quality_monitoring))
- `databricks_model_serving_metrics` (Attributes) Health and usage metrics for your Databricks model serving endpoints. Not supported on accounts that authenticate with `private_action_runner`; on those accounts this dataflow collects no data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_model_serving_metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_cloud_cost_metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.databricks_cloud_cost_metrics`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the Cloud Cost Management dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_cloud_cost_metrics--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_cloud_cost_metrics--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.databricks_cloud_cost_metrics.settings`

Optional:

- `ccm_collect_all_workspaces` (Boolean) Whether cost data is collected for every workspace in the Databricks account rather than this workspace only. This takes effect across the Databricks account: if any one workspace enables it, Datadog collects cost data for all of them regardless of their individual settings, and every covered workspace incurs Cloud Cost Management charges.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_data_observability_jobs_monitoring"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.databricks_data_observability_jobs_monitoring`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the Data Jobs Monitoring dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_data_observability_jobs_monitoring--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_data_observability_jobs_monitoring--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.databricks_data_observability_jobs_monitoring.settings`

Optional:

- `dd_api_key_id` (String) ID of the Datadog API key the global init script uses to submit data.
- `dd_api_key_secret_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret value of the Datadog API key identified by `dd_api_key_id`. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state.
- `dd_api_key_secret_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for dd_api_key_secret_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.
- `djm_global_init_script_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog installs and manages the Agent on your Databricks clusters through a global init script. The script does not apply to clusters in Standard access mode. When `false`, the Agent is installed manually.
- `script_gpum_enabled` (Boolean) Whether GPU metrics are collected from your Databricks clusters. The Agent installed by the global init script performs the collection, so this requires the dataflow to be enabled with `djm_global_init_script_enabled` set to `true`.
- `script_logs_enabled` (Boolean) Whether driver and worker logs are collected from your Databricks clusters. The Agent installed by the global init script performs the collection, so this requires the dataflow to be enabled with `djm_global_init_script_enabled` set to `true`.
- `serverless_jobs_enabled` (Boolean) Whether health and cost data is collected for jobs running on Serverless or SQL Warehouse compute. This compute has no clusters for the global init script to target, so collection reads the Databricks system tables and requires `system_tables_sql_warehouse_id`.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_data_observability_quality_monitoring"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.databricks_data_observability_quality_monitoring`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the Data Observability dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_data_observability_quality_monitoring--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_data_observability_quality_monitoring--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.databricks_data_observability_quality_monitoring.settings`

Optional:

- `do_crawlers_cron` (String) Cron expression setting how often Datadog connects to your Databricks warehouse to collect metadata. Currently, only hourly (`0 * * * *`) and daily (`0 0 * * *`) are supported.
- `sync_system_catalog` (Boolean) Whether metadata from the Databricks `system` catalog is included in Data Observability alongside your data catalogs.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--databricks_model_serving_metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.databricks_model_serving_metrics`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.
